topics.title_zh: Anthropic万亿估值IPO引发全球科技股集体跳水
topics.title_en: Anthropic’s $1.5 Trillion IPO Triggers Global Tech Stock Sell-off
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic以1.5万亿美元估值在纳斯达克挂牌，引发资本市场对AI泡沫的恐慌性重估。尽管Iconiq资本获得超4倍回报，但软银、台积电等亚洲巨头股价因对AI不可持续的高估值担忧而剧烈波动，市值蒸发规模空前。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic’s $1.5 trillion Nasdaq debut ignited a violent market revaluation. While Iconiq Capital secured a 430%+ return, the euphoria triggered massive sell-offs in Asian giants like SoftBank and TSMC, as investors scrambled to hedge against unsustainable AI valuations and potential bubble bursts.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 硅谷风投及激进扩张型投资人
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Silicon Valley VCs and growth-stage investors
perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为Anthropic不仅是模型厂商，更是重塑人类生产力的基础设施，万亿市值是AGI时代定价权的必然溢价，任何短期回撤都是为了更长期的护城河筑底。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argue that Anthropic is not just a model vendor but the infrastructure for global productivity, justifying a trillion-dollar valuation as a necessary entry price for controlling the AGI era.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 华尔街金融分析师与避险基金经理
perspective_con.speaker_en: Wall Street analysts and hedge fund managers
perspective_con.point_zh: 指出AI模型商业化落地远未支撑如此恐怖的市盈率，Anthropic IPO背后的资本狂欢已脱离基本面，高估值将加速二级市场抛售并对供应链上下游产生反噬。
perspective_con.point_en: Critique the astronomical P/E ratios that ignore current commercial realities; they view the IPO as a dangerous bubble that threatens to drain liquidity from the broader hardware and chip supply chain.

linked_tweets.author: Swyx (Shawn Wang)
linked_tweets.content_zh:
当滚动社交媒体时，我认为值得记住的是，你可以说“达到 SOTA 的几率已降至零”并获得很多赞，然后 3 个月后，当他们达到 SOTA 时，你发布道歉表格并获得更多赞，你的写作主题将其打印出来并感谢你的动力

不准确完全不会产生任何后果，并且每一个夸大其辞的动机都可以，并且 x 算法已针对此进行了调整
linked_tweets.content_en:
when scrolling social media i think it is worth bearing in mind that you can say “odds of reaching SOTA have dropped to zero” and get alot of likes and then 3 months later when they have reached SOTA you post apology form and get even more likes and the subject of your writing prints it out and thanks you for motivation

theres no consequences at all for inaccuracy and every incentive for hyperbole and the x algorithm is tuned for this

topics.title_zh: 黄仁勋离任丑闻与加州司法调查英伟达
topics.title_en: Nvidia Under Judicial Probe Following Jensen Huang’s Sudden Resignation
topics.summary_zh: 黄仁勋因婚外情丑闻意外辞去英伟达CEO职务，加州总检察长随即对公司发起司法调查。此事件叠加俄籍间谍窃取国防科技情报的阴云，令英伟达深陷监管与信誉旋涡，股价较近期高点已回调近40%。
topics.summary_en: Following Jensen Huang’s resignation amid a personal scandal, the California Attorney General has issued subpoenas to Nvidia. This corporate crisis, compounded by revelations of Russian espionage targeting Silicon Valley defense tech, has created a regulatory perfect storm for the chip giant.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 英伟达内部留任高管与忠实股东
perspective_pro.point_zh: 强调技术路线与算力霸权不受单一高管离职影响，认为当前的司法调查与舆论压力仅是政客干扰自由商业生态的短期骚扰。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argue that the technical trajectory and dominance of Nvidia are independent of leadership changes, dismissing judicial probes as mere political interference in free-market dynamics.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 国会议员与企业治理专家
perspective_con.speaker_en: Congressional committees and corporate governance experts
perspective_con.point_zh: 认为黄仁勋事件揭开了英伟达缺乏透明度治理的盖子，且公司在处理敏感技术出海及国家安全间谍风险上存在严重渎职，必须进行根本性整改。
perspective_con.point_en: Argue that the scandal exposes deep-seated governance failures at Nvidia, demanding accountability for lax oversight in tech exports and potential compromises in national security.

linked_tweets.author: monokern
linked_tweets.content_zh:
这是我使用的 GTA VI PC 设置。这太他妈简单了...

是的，你可以在没有 PS5 的情况下做到这一点

我使用 - RTX 5090、 - Ryzen 9 9950X3D 和 - 240 Hz 显示器。设置背后的应用程序是免费的，在 Windows 11 上运行，并且在 GitHub 上已经拥有 4k+ 颗星。

我的设置方法如下：

1. 前往 GitHub →
在“版本”下，获取 NVIDIA ZIP，将其解压缩，然后运行该应用程序

2. 选择 PS5 作为源并通过 Remote Play 进行配对。首先让图片和控制器工作

3. 打开 Professional → List，将 NVIDIA VFG 设置为 Low（8 倍）。在我的显示器上，帧速率从 30 FPS 提升到 240 FPS

Claude Code 帮助我为我的构建选择正确的设置

顺便说一句，一位朋友给了我访问他的 PS5 的权限

我的所有设置都在屏幕截图中
linked_tweets.content_en:
HERE'S THE GTA VI PC SETUP I USED. IT'S EASY AS FUCK...

and yeah, you can do it without owning a PS5

I used - RTX 5090, - Ryzen 9 9950X3D, and - 240 Hz monitor. App behind the setup is free, runs on Windows 11, and already has 4k+ stars on GitHub.

here's how I set it up:

1. go to GitHub → https://t.co/L8xjBqSj47
under Releases, grab the NVIDIA ZIP, unzip it, and run the app

2. pick PS5 as your source and pair it through Remote Play. get the picture and controller working first

3. open Professional → List and set NVIDIA VFG to Low at 8×. that took the 30 FPS feed up to 240 FPS on my monitor

Claude Code helped me pick the right settings for my build

btw, a friend gave me access to his PS5

all my settings are in the screenshot

topics.title_zh: 苹果招募工程师研发自主AI操控代理
topics.title_en: Apple Aggressively Hiring to Build Autonomous Device-Control AI Agents
topics.summary_zh: 苹果正式启动自主AI代理系统的研发，旨在实现跨应用操作、编码及网页浏览。此举直接挑战当前AI搜索聊天模式，意在通过设备端控制权的掌握，重构人机交互入口，与谷歌Gemini的桌面自动化控制功能展开直接竞争。
topics.summary_en: Apple is aggressively recruiting to build autonomous AI agents capable of cross-app manipulation, coding, and web navigation. This move seeks to redefine the UI by moving beyond chat to active device control, positioning Apple in direct competition with Google’s Gemini desktop automation suite.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 苹果生态原教旨主义者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 苹果研发部门与果粉社区
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Apple R&D teams and the enthusiast community
perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为只有苹果拥有最深层的操作系统权限，能够构建真正保护隐私且无缝连接的AI代理，这是对以对话为主的浅层AI模式的重大降维打击。
perspective_pro.point_en: Believe that Apple’s unique OS-level integration is the only path to a private, seamless agent, effectively rendering web-based chatbots obsolete through native control.

perspective_con.point_zh: 质疑苹果的封闭式代理生态将再次形成“孤岛效应”，通过限制API和系统权限，剥夺开发者利用LLM进行深度开发的创新权利，拖累AI自动化的演进速度。
perspective_con.point_en: Criticize Apple’s 'walled garden' approach, arguing that restrictive APIs will stifle developer innovation and hinder the rapid, collaborative evolution of open AI agents.
